EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
CO-OPERATIVE SOCIETIES LAW No. 5 OF 1972 READ WITH THE CO-OPERATIVE SOCIETIES(AMENDMENT) ACT, No. 32 OF 1983 AND THE CO-OPERATIVE SOCIETIES (AMENDMENT)ACT, No. 11 OF 1992

IN pursuance of the powers vested in me under the Section 2(2) of the Co-operative Societies Law, No. 5 of 1972 readwith Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Act, No. 32 of 1983 and the Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Act, No. 11of 1992, I, Rishad Bathiudeen, Minister of Industry and Commerce do hereby confer on the persons appointed to assistthe Commissioner of Co-operative Development and the Registrar of Co-operative Societies and specified in the ColumnI of the Schedule hereto, from the date specified in Column II under Co-operative Societies Law, No. 5 of 1972 read withCo-operative Societies (Amendment) Act, No. 32 of 1983 and the Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Act, No. 11 of1992 and under the rules made thereunder, the powers specified in Column III of the said Schedule.
RISHAD BATHIUDEEN,Minister of Industry and Commerce.Colombo,07th September 2016.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
